name: Thaumaturgy (Rituals) — 2 Intermediate — Return of the Heart

system.description: By mixing a Blood Trait from the victim with the tears of an infant, the thaumaturge forces her target to reflect upon her past through the eyes of an innocent. For the rest of the evening the target behaves as though she followed the Path of Humanity with a rating of 5, likely prompting Conscience or Conviction Virtue tests at the Storyteller's discretion. (Path of the Blood's Curse)
